name: Tebbs

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large multi-section residence with a brown multi-gable roof|A paved driveway and parking area serve the front and side of the house|Extensive landscaped gardens, lawn areas, and mature trees surround the structure|Open space and additional paved areas are present around the home|The property is set in a semi-rural area with neighboring homes nearby|The street wraps around the property, giving potential access on all sides.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a large multi-section home with a brown multi-gable roof and light exterior|A paved walkway and driveway lead to the main entry|Extensive landscaped plantings, shrubs, and trees fill the front yard|Vehicles are parked in the driveway area to one side.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side elevation of the multi-section home|Mature trees and landscaped vegetation surround this side|Portions of the roof and structure are visible through the tree cover|Open ground and garden areas continue along the property edge.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back elevation of the large home with multiple windows and outdoor living areas|Mature trees and landscaped vegetation surround the rear of the property|Open space and slopes are visible beyond the immediate yard.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side of the multi-section home and portions of the paved driveway|Mature trees and landscaped plantings run along this side|The structure is partially screened by vegetation.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that leads from the street to the front and side of the residence, with space for vehicle staging. The front of the property is open and clearly accessible. Mature trees and dense landscaping surround much of the house and may limit visibility and movement in some areas. Open lawn and garden spaces provide additional room near the structure. The property is located in a semi-rural residential setting with road access.
clarifications: Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property? Is vehicle or pedestrian access available to the rear of the house? Are there any additional access points or pathways not visible from the available imagery? How dense is the tree and landscaping coverage for emergency vehicle and personnel movement around the full perimeter of the residence?
